people.name: Matthew
people.line: Apostle, tax collector, author of the Gospel of Matthew.

translations.web: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
translations.bsb: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him,
translations.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
translations.asv: And after these things he went forth, and beheld a publican, named Levi, sitting at the place of toll, and said unto him, Follow me.
